_meta.description: Phase 4e (s187, 2026-05-13) + Phase 5.9.14 (s201, 2026-05-14) Riven seed + Phase 5.9.18 (s205, 2026-05-14) Qiyana/AurelionSol/Renekton seed — per-(champion, key) form_index_overrides for the ds.ability + ds.burst scorers. Default form_index=0 picks the first form in the snapshot, which is fine for ~95% of multi-form champions but materially wrong for a handful where form 0 has no damage blocks or carries weaker scaling than a later form. Keys are DDragon canonical ids; values map ability key (Q/W/E/R) to the 0-indexed form_index to use when the operator doesn't supply an explicit dict. Operator's per-call dict still wins per-key — registry fills any keys the caller didn't override.
_meta.rationale:
Per-champion examples (verified against data/daemon_slayer/16.10.1/champion_abilities.json):
  Nidalee Q form 1 = Takedown (5 damage blocks vs Javelin Toss's 2; cougar form is the burst rotation)
  Nidalee W form 1 = Pounce (cougar AoE), E form 1 = Swipe (cougar AoE; form 0 Primal Surge is a heal with no damage)
  Elise Q form 1 = Venomous Bite (spider execute scaling; same blocks but the play pattern flips to spider for melee burst)
  Jayce Q form 1 = Shock Blast (cannon orb; 2 blocks vs hammer leap's 1)
  Hwei Q form 1 = Devastating Fire (form 0 is the stance-setup 'Subject: Disaster' which has zero damage blocks); W form 3 = Stirring Lights (W forms 0/1/2 are all dt=None utility); E form 1 = Grim Visage (form 0 is another stance setup)
  LeeSin Q form 1 = Resonating Strike (the Q recast; 2 blocks vs initial Sonic Wave's 1)
  Riven R form 1 = Wind Slash (form 0 'Blade of the Exile' has zero damage blocks; form 1 is the recast execute) — added s204
  Qiyana Q form 1 = Elemental Wrath (form 0 is the base Edge of Ixtal; form 1 is the elementally-empowered cast which is canonical Qiyana usage). Same Physical Damage values in block 0 of both forms — form_index alone is a no-op for Qiyana Q; the s205 block_index registry routes form 1 to block 2 'Increased Damage' (1.6× base + 1.6% bAD) to capture the empowered burst — added s205
  AurelionSol R form 1 = The Skies Descend (form 0 'Falling Star' is the base R; form 1 is the empowered cast at full Stardust). Block 0 of form 1 'Empowered Magic Damage' is 1.25× form 0 base + 1.25× AP scaling — operator commits to using R with full Stardust the same way Renekton commits to full Fury (s197) — added s205
  Renekton E form 1 = Dice (form 0 'Slice' is the first cast; form 1 is the empowered Dice after consuming 50 Fury). Form 1 block 3 'Total Physical Damage' captures the full Slice + empowered Dice combo via the s205 block_index registry (block 3 = block 0 sum + Bonus = 2.75× form 0 at rank 1) — added s205

Deliberately skipped:
  Aphelios — all 6 Q forms parsed as no_damage by the Meraki extractor; data gap blocks scoring (deferred to a future patch when the formulas land)
  Karma — mantra-amped forms are a player choice mid-combat, not a default
  Khazix — evolved forms are a player choice per-game, not a default
  Gnar — form 0 is mini Gnar (the iconic poke form); default 0 is correct
  Heimerdinger — H-28G base turret (form 0) is the typical case; form 1 is ult-amped
  Ambessa — form swaps within ability casts (Q/W/E carry Drain state but form_index can't model resource-driven amp; tracked separately under the s197/s198 block_index resource-amp pattern)
  TwistedFate W (Pick a Card) — 3 player-choice forms (blue/red/gold); not a default-amped form
  TahmKench R form 1 (Regurgitate) — player-choice mid-channel, not the canonical Devour use case
  Quinn R form 1 (Skystrike) — 0 damage blocks in Meraki snapshot
